svg.text: THE WORLD IN ONE PAGE
WEDNESDAY • 25 NOVEMBER 2026 • 36 STORIES • ONE DAY ON EARTH
Gulf tankers burn • US tariffs hit 14 partners • Pakistan reaches orbit — plus markets, courts, climate and sport, all dated 25 November 2026.

g.text: HERO • THE STRAIT OF HORMUZ — TANKERS ABLAZE AT DUSK
HERO • SHENZHOU-24 — PAKISTAN'S FIRST ASTRONAUT LIFTS OFF

svg.text: 1 • LEAD • GULF
STRAIT OF HORMUZ
Tankers ablaze in the Strait
of Hormuz
Iran's Revolutionary Guard says two oil
tankers struck naval mines and caught fire
on an unauthorised route.
2 • LEAD • TRADE
WASHINGTON
US proposes tariffs on 14
trading partners
The US proposes 20–40% duties on China, the
EU, India and 11 others. Markets tumble; a
hearing is set for 25 January.
3 • LEAD • SPACE
JIUQUAN, CHINA
Pakistan's first astronaut
reaches orbit
Shenzhou-24 lifts off at 08:18 Beijing time
and docks with Tiangong. Zeeshan Ali is the
first Pakistani in orbit.

g.text: THE WORLD TODAY — WHERE THE NEWS HAPPENED
Numbers match the story numbers below • Schematic map, not to scale

svg.text: THE DAY IN DEPTH — 12 MORE STORIES
Houthis strike Ras Tanura refinery
Houthis claim a hit on Saudi Arabia's largest
refinery; a Riyadh tower strike injured 11.
Ukraine drones set two refineries
ablaze
Syzran and Kuibyshev refineries burn; Russia
hits Odesa and Kyiv, killing two.
Stocks slide as AI rally unravels
S&P 500 falls 2.2%, Nasdaq 3.2%; Seoul's KOSPI
plunges 6.2% and Tokyo's Nikkei 2.8%.
Huawei convicted in US fraud trial
A Brooklyn jury finds Huawei guilty on 10 of
12 counts, including bank fraud.
Australia–Solomons sign security
treaty
The pact bars any foreign military base on
Solomon Islands.
Spain heads to snap election on
Sunday
Polls put the People's Party ahead, short of a
majority; Vox could enter government.
Poland plans no-fly zone on
Ukraine border
After Russian drones entered its airspace,
Warsaw plans a zone to shoot down intruders.
RSF drone strikes kill 19
civilians
Emergency Lawyers says paramilitary drones hit
two cities, killing 19 and wounding 20.
All hostages freed in supermarket
siege
Colombian forces storm an Éxito store after a
17-hour siege; all hostages freed.
Pope laments collapse of COP31
talks
Pope Leo XIV voices dismay as the Antalya
summit ends with no climate deal.
Shanghai party chief probed for
graft
Chen Jining is the fourth Politburo member
probed since 2025 as Xi's crackdown spreads.
US weighs strikes on Iranian
leaders
Washington is reported to weigh strikes on
senior Iranian figures as the crisis deepens.
ALSO TODAY — 21 IN BRIEF
• GAZA — Israel kills Hamas security chief Abuelouf in a strike.
• UKRAINE — Leaked figures put Russian war dead at 490,334.
• NIGER — Suspected IS militants kidnap a Saudi national.
• INDIA — Delhi tells 'cockroach' leader Das not to use his passport.
• WASHINGTON — Senator Booker questions Nvidia over Huang's return.
• AUSTIN — Dell posts record Q3 revenue of $54.9bn on AI servers.
• BOGOR — Toll rises to six in a flooded illegal gold mine.
• BENGHAZI — Two Libyan officers die of wounds from a sea-drone hit.
• LONDON — Poundland collapses; about 11,000 jobs at risk.
• LONDON — UK energy price cap to rise 26% in January.
• BUENOS AIRES — Argentina slips into technical recession.
• PRETORIA — Ramaphosa wins court battle over impeachment threat.
• BERLIN — Merz warns Russia wants more than Ukraine.
• PYONGYANG — North Korea expels a Swiss diplomat.
• JERUSALEM — Knesset advances inquiry into 7 October attacks.
• WASHINGTON — US reports three bird-flu cases, one death.
• REDMOND — Microsoft declares 'Code Red' after a 24-hour outage.
• WASHINGTON — Trump to award Giuliani the Medal of Freedom.
• SAN JUAN — Jennifer Barreto of Puerto Rico wins Miss Universe.
• BRUSSELS — EU unveils a €50bn quantum and tech fund.
• KYIV — Ukraine says five Russian jets hit in an airfield strike.
All 36 stories dated and checked against live reporting for 25 Nov 2026 — Reuters, BBC, Just Security, AP via One Turn, Euronews. Tanker figures are as claimed by Iran's IRGC.
